column2: Constructs the sigma of left modules, opposite-ring modules and commuting actions, then supplies the regular and commutative-ring instances.

ReviewedOriginalWattsConnection closes the article's arbitrary unital two-ring statement through originalWattsWithEvaluation, the balanced universal property and both map formulas, strict evaluation with the right action, the tensor associator and the regular tensor unit. The statement uses Bimodule for its action type. CanonicalWattsComparison, ModuleTensorUniversalProperty, NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctors and RegularModuleRightAction are unused imports because the connection supplies their required roles through the WattsFoundation construction. The Stacks endofunctor result requires one commutative ring and ring-linearity. Its separate cofan lemma requires both mapped cofans to be colimits and every summand component to be an isomorphism. Both Stacks declarations audit with Classical.choice and supply no part of this proof. The selected article statement is the one checked here, and the separately scoped choice-free WattsFreePresentation is outside this plan.

Uses the particular equivalence chosen from EilenbergWatts. The linearity criterion follows by checking scalar identities on pure tensors and using the retraction at the lifted regular module, then the equivalence restricts to the two reviewed full subcategories.
